description:
In this episode, we’ll be diving into a viewer’s thoughtful question: How do we keep the Sabbath holy? We’ll explore what the Bible says about setting aside a day for rest, worship, and connecting with God, and how we can apply this in our busy lives. Plus, we’ll answer other insightful questions from our viewers about faith, daily living, and growing closer to God.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. How do we keep the Sabbath holy? I know we don't talk politics during Sabbath hours, but what else should we not do? 
 
2. Where in the Bible does it indicate there will be no more grace to be saved, once the plagues begin to fall. 
 
3. Can you please explain Job 35:5-16? 
 
4. Can you explain Ephesians 6:5-9? How does this correlate with slavery in American History? In the Bible when it says to obey thy master what does this mean? 
 
5. Genesis 6:4 mentions the sons of God being from Seth's lineage but who were the Nephilim? Who did Cain have a family with if there were no women or daughters on the earth except Eve herself? After all, he did depart from his original family. Can you please explain this? 
 
6. Should we keep the feast days? 
 
7. Since a Biblical day starts at sundown, how could Christ's suffering begin on Thursday evening in the Garden as it is frequently represented as the beginning of the 3 days of suffering? Would that not be observed in Biblical time as Friday already, just as Sabbath observance begins at sundown on Friday evening? This still leaves all day Friday, Sabbath, and part of Sunday which is 3 days of suffering. Can you please explain Jesus' three days of suffering?
 
8. If someone had sex realignment and identified as the opposite sex from their birth subsequently becomes converted and accepts Christ as Saviour, and then dies, when they are resurrected, which body would they have? Would it be the one given at birth or the later realigned one? What body are we resurrected with?
 
9. Is God the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit one being or three? 
 
10. Can you please explain 1 Samuel 16:14? Does God send evil spirits to those who refuse to do His will? 
 
11. Why did God create darkness/night in creation even though there was no sin? Revelation says there will be no more night, so that must mean that Heaven will be an endless day. Why then did God create darkness during creation? Why did God create night?
 
12. Can you please explain the Second Coming? I know Jesus' feet will not touch the Earth and take up the dead and us who are alive to be with Him. What happens to the people on Earth after this takes place? Is that when tribulation comes?
